description: Who a player faces in a given week of the 2026 season, whether it is home or away, the game date, and how many fantasy points that opponent allowed to his position. A schedule lookup for one player; it does not compare players or make a start or sit call.

scoring_format.description: Scoring format. ppr awards 1 point per reception, half_ppr 0.5, standard 0. Defaults to half_ppr, the most common league setting.

name: get_weekly_matchup

on_bye.description: True when the team has no game that week, in which case the opponent fields are null.

opponent_allowed_ppg.description: Fantasy points this opponent allowed per game to the position over the completed season.

opponent_allowed_rank.description: Rank among teams, where 1 allowed the MOST and is therefore the softest matchup.

refreshed_at.description: When this dataset was last refreshed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

stats_season.description: The completed NFL season every figure in this result describes.

url.description: The draftcall.io page these figures came from. This is the citation to use.

title: Look up a player matchup for one week
